'''Rod Latham ISB Manipulator''' is a [[Dark]] deck by [[Rod Latham]], published on [[Trandosite]].<ref name="trandosite">[http://www.trandosite.mcmail.com/ds59.htm ISB Manipulator], [[Trandosite]] ([[Rod Latham]]). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20010228054721/http://www.trandosite.mcmail.com:80/ds59.htm Internet Archive]</ref>
